description: Posts an incident banner on a status page, for example "API degraded". It shows on the page at once, pinned and active, alongside any other active incidents. Follow up with updateIncident as things change, and resolveIncident when it is over.

content.description: Body of the banner, in Markdown

slug.description: The status page slug. Find slugs with listStatusPages.

style.description: Banner color (default: primary). primary, info, warning, danger, light or dark

name: createIncident

content.description: Markdown, as the status page renders it

createdDate.description: UTC, as Uptime Kuma stores it

lastUpdatedDate.description: UTC, as Uptime Kuma stores it

pin.description: Shown on the status page while also active

style.description: Banner style: info, warning, danger, primary, light, dark
